purpose: 126 independently recorded CUDA fused_dropout mask/counter oracles (3 seeds x 7 sizes x {float32, float64} x 3 drop probabilities x the recorded vector width). They are expected outputs for the CUDA-compatible dropout parity tests. Diagnostic oracles only: product code never imports them and they are never used as model input.

source.recorded_on: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 with the original CUDA native_dropout/fused_dropout kernels
source.note: The listed recording path is relative to the migration example root and is read-only host content; it is not part of the migrated tree.

revalidation.note: Byte identical to the primary oracle, so the mask algorithm and the recorded counter advances are stable across torch 2.3.1+cu118 and torch 2.5.1+cu124 on the same 132 SM / 2048-thread H100 profile.

contract_recorded_by_the_asset.mask_sha256: sha256 of the C-order uint8 0/1 keep mask (mask != 0), the same convention the CPU Bernoulli stream uses
contract_recorded_by_the_asset.vec: vector width the recording forced for the case; sizes 3/21/1025/4097 use 1, sizes 6/478 use 2, size 300000 uses 4
contract_recorded_by_the_asset.mismatch: number of mask elements that differed from the independently derived derivation (0 for every case)

usage_restriction: Expected outputs only. The tests never relax, regenerate or derive an expectation from the candidate module, and nothing in src/ reads these files.
